name: handmark.io
description: Password-protected Handmark sales and application flow for human-made work verification.

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:dev && concurrently -k -n browser,server -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:browser" "pnpm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:server: env HANDMARK_LOAD_ENV_FILE=false APP_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4230 DATA_DIR=.run/dev/data DB_PATH=.run/dev/data/handmark.sqlite HANDMARK_PASSWORD=handmark-local-development-password HOST=127.0.0.1 NODE_ENV=development PORT=4230 SESSION_SECRET=handmark-local-development-session-secret SITE_BROWSER_DIR="$PWD/.run/dev/browser-output/browser" server/node_modules/.bin/tsx watch server/src/index.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run build:browser && pnpm run build:server
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:app && pnpm run typecheck:server
scripts.test:server: pnpm run build:server && pnpm --filter handmark-server run test && node --test tests/server/e2e-harness-contract.test.mjs tests/server/launchd-contract.test.mjs tests/server/server-contract.test.mjs tests/server/import-contract.test.mjs tests/server/verify-import-contract.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run platform:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
